items.title: MoRTH to Organise “Chintan Shivir 2026” to Shape Future-Ready, Safe and High-Quality Highway Infrastructure
items.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport & Highways will organise Chintan Shivir 2026 on 5–6 October 2026 at Ekta Nagar, Narmada District, Gujarat, bringing together senior representatives from the Centre, States and implementing agencies to deliberate on key issues concerning the development and delivery of highway…
key_facts: The inaugural session on 5 October will feature addresses by Minister of Road Transport & Highways Shri Nitin Gadkari and Ministers of State Shri Ajay Tamta and Shri Harsh Malhotra.
Road Transport and Public Works Ministers from States, along with senior officials of State PWDs, implementing agencies and other stakeholders, have been invited to participate in the Chintan Shivir.

items.title: Union Environment Minister releases two male Great Indian Bustards into the wild at Desert National Park, Jaisalmer
items.summary: In a significant milestone for the conservation of the critically endangered Great Indian Bustard (GIB), Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Shri Bhupender Yadav, today released two male GIBs into the wild at Sam in the Desert National Park, Jaisalmer, Rajasthan.

items.title: Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 Concludes at AIIA; Special Campaign 6.0 to Continue Till 31 October
items.summary: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi, concluded the Swachhata Hi Seva (SHS) Campaign 2026 on October 2, 2026.
key_facts: Organised by the Department of Swasthavritta and Yoga, AIIA, the campaign was conducted from September 17 to October 2, 2026, under the theme “Swachhata Mein Sabhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat”.

items.title: Prime Minister congratulates Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning Silver in Women’s Team Golf at Asian Games
items.summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning the Silver medal in the Women’s Team Golf event at the Asian Games 2026. The Prime Minister said that their success highlights their determination and passion for the sport.
key_facts: Shri Modi wished Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar continued success and expressed hope that they attain new heights of success in the times to come.

In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office said; “Kudos to Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar on winning the Silver Medal in the Women’s Team Golf event at the Asian Games 2026 yesterday.
Shri Modi wished Aditi Ashok, Pranavi Sharath Urs and Diksha Dagar continued success and expressed hope that they attain new heights of success in the times to come.

items.title: Prime Minister congratulates Antim Panghal on winning Silver in Women’s 53 kg Freestyle Wrestling at Asian Games
items.summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has congratulated Antim Panghal on winning the Silver medal in the Women’s 53 kg Freestyle Wrestling event at the Asian Games. The Prime Minister described her performance as exemplary and said that she delivered a wonderful performance.

items.title: Prime Minister pays homage to freedom fighter Shyamji Krishna Varma on his birth anniversary
items.summary: The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has paid homage to great revolutionary and freedom fighter Shyamji Krishna Varma on his birth anniversary. The Prime Minister said that Shyamji Krishna Varma dedicated his life to breaking the shackles of subjugation of Maa Bharati.

items.title: Prime Minister compliments Indian contingent on its performance at Asian Games 2026
items.summary: As the Asian Games 2026 draw to a close, the Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, complimented every member of the Indian contingent for representing the nation with determination, passion and remarkable sporting spirit.
key_facts: The Prime Minister congratulated all the medal winners whose performances have brought immense joy to the nation.
Shri Modi expressed hope that the Games inspire even greater achievements in the years ahead and contribute to strengthening sports at the grassroots.
“As the Asian Games 2026 draw to a close, my compliments to every member of the Indian contingent for representing our nation with determination, passion and remarkable sporting spirit.

items.title: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal to Flag Off First International Cargo Voyage from Dibrugarh
items.summary: The Union Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Sarbananda Sonowal, will flag off the first international cargo voyage from Dibrugarh tomorrow, 5 October 2026, at 11:00 AM at Bogibeel Terminal, Dibrugarh. The Chief Minister of Assam, Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma, will join the ceremony virtually as Chief Guest.
items.ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
key_facts: It will be the first time since Independence that a cargo consignment sails from Dibrugarh to a foreign port.

items.title: DRI seizes around 7 kg amphetamine, 5 kg cocaine and 3.5 kg heroin in three operations as it intensifies crackdown on drug trafficking; 5 arrested
items.summary: Continuing its sustained crackdown on illicit drug trafficking, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has seized cumulative quantity of 15.59 kg dangerous contraband drugs, Amphetamine, Cocaine and Heroin, in three separate intelligence-led operations conducted on 29–30.09.2026.
key_facts: Five persons have been arrested under the provisions of the NDPS Act, 1985.

In a dramatic operation on 30.09.2026, DRI, along with the Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN), intercepted a Mahindra Thar suspected to be carrying Amphetamine at the Ujjain–Dewas Toll Plaza in Madhya Pradesh.
The officers pursued the vehicle in a high-speed chase lasting approximately 1.5 hours, before successfully intercepting it near Bicholi Mardana, Indore.

items.title: Reforms aimed at empowering cotton farmers, enhancing transparency and strengthening India’s cotton value chain to take centre stage
items.summary: Ministry of Textile, Government of India through its Cotton Corporation of India Ltd. (CCI), a Public Sector Undertaking, will organize a special showcase event on 6th October 2026 in Hyderabad, Telangana, as part of ‘Reform Utsav 2026’.
key_facts: The event will bring together senior government officials, representatives of the Government of Telangana, policymakers, farmers, industry associations and other stakeholders from the cotton and textile sectors.
It will provide a platform to highlight the impact of reforms on the ground and facilitate experience-sharing among key stakeholders across the cotton value chain.
These interventions are aimed at improving ease of doing business, strengthening transparency and accountability, and ensuring more efficient delivery of services to cotton farmers.

items.title: Modi government's historic move to provide 3 lakh permanent houses to Andhra Pradesh; Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Shri Chandrababu Naidu sound the clarion call for massive development from Burripalem
items.summary: Giving fresh momentum to the holistic and rural development of Andhra Pradesh, Union Minister for Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare and Rural Development, Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan, presided over a significant event in Burripalem village, Guntur district, on Sunday.
key_facts: A major initiative involving the construction of 3 lakh permanent houses at a cost of ₹3,600 crore in the state was launched.

Union Minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan and Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Shri Nara Chandrababu Naidu jointly launched housing projects for 3 lakh permanent houses under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin 2.0).
Additionally, a pilot project featuring the country's first 3D-constructed houses—built at a cost of ₹14 crore—was inaugurated.

items.title: India’s Rising Supercomputing Ecosystem
items.summary: India’s supercomputing journey has evolved from PARAM 8000 in the early 1990s to a national ecosystem under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM), launched in 2015. With 40 supercomputers delivering 68 PF as of September 2026, NSM is expanding access to high-performance computing (HPC).
key_facts: They also enable faster analysis and help researchers address increasingly complex scientific challenges.
Supercomputers are high-performance computing systems designed to process complex calculations at exceptional speeds.
They combine large numbers of processors to perform multiple calculations simultaneously.

items.title: Shivraj Singh Chouhan Hands Over 3 Lakh Houses Worth ₹3,600 Crore to Andhra Pradesh, Lays Foundation for India’s First 3D Concrete-Printed Housing Project
items.summary: Guntur (Andhra Pradesh)/New Delhi | October 4, 2026 | Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare and Rural Development Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan on Sunday handed over the first instalment of 3 lakh houses worth ₹3,600 crore to Andhra Pradesh under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin 2.0 at an event in…
key_facts: Chandrababu Naidu, Chouhan also laid the foundation stone for the country’s first pilot housing project using 3D concrete printing technology, comprising 177 houses at a cost of ₹14 crore.
However, following Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu’s request to ensure that every poor family in the state had a permanent home, the allocation was increased to 3 lakh houses.
With the blessings of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, we have sanctioned 3 lakh houses instead of 76,000,” he said.

items.title: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh Hosts Lunch for Delhi based Medical Alumni from Jammu, Recalls His Days as Professor in GMC Jammu

key_facts: The doctors shared their experiences and recalled their days as students, making the lunch a warm reunion with their former teacher.
The former students recalled attending Dr. Jitendra Singh’s classes and shared memories of their academic years at Government Medical College, Jammu.

From specialised clinical care to medical education and healthcare administration, the former students have pursued diverse professional paths and continue to contribute to the healthcare sector in different capacities.

items.title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan Addresses Mahaparva Kshamapana Ceremony in New Delhi
items.summary: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan today addressed the Mahaparva Kshamapana Ceremony – 2026, organised by the Bhagwan Mahavir Memorial Committee and Jain Mahasabha Delhi at Vigyan Bhawan, New Delhi.
key_facts: He described the occasion as a celebration of universal values of forgiveness, friendship, non-violence and inner purification.
Radhakrishnan addressed the Mahaparva Kshamapana Ceremony-2026 in New Delhi, highlighting the timeless Jain values of forgiveness, Ahimsa, friendship and compassion.
He recalled the contributions of Jain scholars and monks to classical Tamil literature and noted the presence of ancient Jain temples and centres of learning across Tamil Nadu.

items.title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan Addresses 58th Foundation Day of ICSI at Bharat Mandapam
items.summary: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan today addressed the 58th Foundation Day celebrations of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

Asish Mohan, among others, were present on the occasion.

items.title: Dr. Jitendra Singh to chair the 17th Pension Adalat at IIPA, New Delhi, on 05.10.2026
items.summary: The Pension Adalat is an innovative initiative undertaken by the Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare (DoPPW) for the on-the-spot redressal of grievances of Central Government pensioners.
items.ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions
key_facts: It provides a common platform for all stakeholders concerned with a particular type of grievance to come together for the resolution of long-pending pension grievances.
Since the introduction by DoPPW in 2017, Pension Adalats have emerged as an efficient and effective mechanism for resolving complicated and long-pending pension grievances.
With a success rate of 71.79%, the Pension Adalat initiative has demonstrated its utility by resolving 20,676 out of a total of 28,797 grievances on the spot across its previous 16 editions.
